Container.Name: discord-summarizer
Container.Overview: Posts a daily digest of one Discord channel. Reads the last day of messages at run time, summarizes them with Claude on a Max subscription, and posts the result through a webhook.

Config.Name: Config Path
Config.Description: Holds state.json (which digest was last posted, so a restart never double-posts) and the Claude CLI's home directory.

Config.Name: Discord Bot Token
Config.Description: Reads the channel history; a webhook can only post. The bot needs View Channel and Read Message History on the source channel, and the Message Content intent enabled in the developer portal.

Config.Name: Source Channel ID
Config.Description: The channel to summarize. Right-click the channel with Developer Mode on, Copy Channel ID.

Config.Name: Webhook URL
Config.Description: Where the digest is posted. May be a webhook on the source channel itself; the bot skips its own posts.

Config.Name: Claude Token
Config.Description: Long-lived subscription token from `claude setup-token`. The same one dm-assistant uses is fine. When it expires (about a year) the bot posts a failure note saying so.

Config.Name: Summary Time
Config.Description: 24-hour wall-clock time of the daily digest, in Summary Timezone.

Config.Name: Summary Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone Summary Time is read in. Independent of the server's own timezone.

Config.Name: Log Timezone
Config.Description: Only affects timestamps in the container log.

Config.Name: Error Webhook URL
Config.Description: Optional. Failure notes go here instead of the main webhook.

Config.Name: Model
Config.Description: Which Claude model writes the digest.

Config.Name: Quiet Day Threshold
Config.Description: Fewer messages than this gets a one-line 'quiet day' note and no Claude call.

Config.Name: Include Bots
Config.Description: Set 1 to include other bots' messages in the digest. The summarizer's own posts are always skipped.

Config.Name: Catch-up Hours
Config.Description: If the container was down at the scheduled time, still post when it comes back within this many hours.

Config.Name: Claude Timeout
Config.Description: Seconds to wait for Claude before retrying once and then posting a failure note.
